claim: The auditable-transformation composition. A sanctioned mutation flows through MARK (attach actor and action) to EMIT (persist a structured record); COVER detects any mutation that escaped attribution; READ reconstructs the transformation history from the records; a FIDELITY GATE checks that the transformed artifact kept its required semantics. Solid path: the core path, every step required.
topology:
A single solid load-bearing chain runs top to bottom. A sanctioned mutation enters. MARK
    attaches actor and action. EMIT persists a structured record. COVER detects any mutation that escaped
    attribution. READ reconstructs the transformation history. The FIDELITY GATE checks that the transformed
    artifact retained its required semantics. Every link is required: attribution without completeness is a
    partial history, completeness without readable provenance proves only that records exist, and provenance
    alone cannot show the product survived. No dashed enhancement in this stack.
required_terms: Every link is required. Attribution, completeness, readable history and product fidelity.
bw_encoding: Ordinary nodes, artifacts, evidence and outcomes are white. Named roles, position and relation styles provide the necessary distinctions.
redesign: Layout reflowed for a 15 cm monochrome print column; color categories replaced by labels and boundary weight.
alt:
The Auditable-Transformation stack: a sanctioned mutation is marked, recorded,
    covered, read back, and gated on fidelity

style_review.fill: Ordinary nodes, artifacts, evidence and outcomes are white. Named roles, position and relation styles provide the necessary distinctions.
style_review.bold: Regular node labels and annotations retained; no arbitrary bold introduced.
style_review.routing: Aligned required spine retained; increased gaps around longer labels and footer. Heavy fidelity-gate boundary retained because the gate can block.
style_review.shape: Ordinary boxes use modest rounded corners; semantic document, state, decision, marker and quantitative shapes retain their roles.
style_review.visual_review: Rendered and visually inspected all 43 pages, including enlarged inspection of revised gate branches and crowded peer junctions. Required dashed relationships, icons, topology, labels and external annotations retained. Geometry checks supplement, rather than replace, visual review.
